notes.title: 2nd patch - more bugfixes!
notes.content:
Hiya, Steam!

Along Together version 1.2.16 is now live, and squashes a few more pesky bugs that have been reported by players since launch:

[list]
[*]Fixed progression blocker in level 3-1 where cars wouldn't respawn after using the car crusher more than 4 times.
[*]The dog no longer can get stuck on the fence at the end of level 3-1.
[*]Fixed physics issue where crushed cars could topple and become unusable.
[*]Fixed case where the crane button could get stuck when pressing the X button multiple times during its animation in level 3-4.
[/list]

This is a really tiny update - about 3 MB - so it should download before you know it. Thanks for your support!!

- Turbo Button Happy Bug Strike Force

notes.title: 1st patch is now live!
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

Thanks so much for checking out Along Together! We pushed our first patch today which fixes some bugs reported by players since our Tuesday. Full notes for version 1.2.14 are below:

[list]
[*] Improved input detection when switching between the face button or trigger to grab objects.
[*] Fixed case where players could get stuck in slingshot mode by pressing the touchpad button and trigger simultaneously.
[*] Moving platforms no longer become stuck if grabbed and released multiple times in rapid succession.
[*] Fixed a spot where the kid could get stuck while moving out of the way of an elevator in level 2-3.
[*] Fixed a spot where the kid could climb into the scenery and get stuck in near the end of level 2-4.
[*] Cars can no longer get offset from their positions on magnetic cranes in world 3.
[/list]

We hope that you won't run into more bugs, but we're committed to fixing them if you do. Thanks!! 

- Turbo Button Happy Bug Strike Force
